args.title: Fix README "Running locally" step referencing missing npm run serve script
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section tells readers to run `npm run serve` after `npm run build`, but no such script exists in package.json, causing a "Missing script: serve" error. Update step 5 to reference the correct start command (e.g. `npm start` or whatever script actually launches the API) so the instructions work as written.
